    bLoad2_Healthy          : BOOL;     (* Load cell 2 transducer plausibility flag *)

    (* --- THERMAL PROCESS TARGETS & BOUNDS (THERMOPLASTIC PEEK / AS4) --- *)

(* === STEP 0: COLD BOOT MATRIX INITIALIZATION & DISCRETIZATION === *)

IF bPyro3_Healthy THEN iPyroHealthyCount := iPyroHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

    IF (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 >= rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2 AND rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 <= rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3) OR
       (rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 <= rLaserTemp_Pyrometer2 AND rLaserTemp_Pyrometer1 >= rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3) THEN

    ELSE

    ELSE rVotedFlashTemp_DegC := rLaserTemp_Pyrometer3;

    rVotedFlashTemp_DegC := x_thermal_est[1];

IF (rLoadDiff_23 > 65.0) AND (rLoadDiff_31 > 65.0) AND bLoad3_Healthy THEN

(* Evaluate healthy load transducer count *)
iLoadHealthyCount := 0;
IF bLoad1_Healthy THEN iLoadHealthyCount := iLoadHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLoad2_Healthy THEN iLoadHealthyCount := iLoadHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bLoad3_Healthy THEN iLoadHealthyCount := iLoadHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Load Cell Median Voter *)
IF iLoadHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    bLoad_TMR_Degraded := FALSE;
    IF (rShoeForce_LoadCell1 >= rShoeForce_LoadCell2 AND rShoeForce_LoadCell1 <= rShoeForce_LoadCell3) OR
       (rShoeForce_LoadCell1 <= rShoeForce_LoadCell2 AND rShoeForce_LoadCell1 >= rShoeForce_LoadCell3) THEN
        rVotedNormalForce_N := rShoeForce_LoadCell1;
    ELSIF (rShoeForce_LoadCell2 >= rShoeForce_LoadCell1 AND rShoeForce_LoadCell2 <= rShoeForce_LoadCell3) OR
          (rShoeForce_LoadCell2 <= rShoeForce_LoadCell1 AND rShoeForce_LoadCell2 >= rShoeForce_LoadCell3) THEN
        rVotedNormalForce_N := rShoeForce_LoadCell2;
    ELSE
        rVotedNormalForce_N := rShoeForce_LoadCell3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iLoadHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bLoad_TMR_Degraded := TRUE;
    IF bLoad1_Healthy AND bLoad2_Healthy THEN
        rVotedNormalForce_N := (rShoeForce_LoadCell1 + rShoeForce_LoadCell2) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bLoad2_Healthy AND bLoad3_Healthy THEN

bDegradedModeActive := bPyro_TMR_Degraded OR bLoad_TMR_Degraded;

(* Calculate Contact Pressure [bar]: P = (F [N] / A [mm2]) * 10.0 [bar / (N/mm2)] *)
rCompactionPressure_bar := (rVotedNormalForce_N / rShoeContactArea_mm2) * 10.0;

(* Temperature-dependent PEEK melt viscosity: mu(T) = A * exp(E_a / (R * T_K)) *)
IF rVotedFlashTemp_DegC > rTemp_GlassTrans_DegC THEN
    rResinViscosity_Pa_s := rVisc_Prefactor_A * EXP(rActivationEnergy_R / (rVotedFlashTemp_DegC + 273.15));
    IF rResinViscosity_Pa_s < 120.0 THEN
        rResinViscosity_Pa_s := 120.0; (* Viscosity asymptote *)
    ELSIF rResinViscosity_Pa_s > 85000.0 THEN
        rResinViscosity_Pa_s := 85000.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rResinViscosity_Pa_s := 100000.0; (* Solid state glassy matrix *)
END_IF;

(* Dwell time under compaction shoe footprint: t_dwell = L_shoe / v_gantry *)
IF rGantryVelocity_Act > 0.015 THEN
    rMaxIntimateContactTime := (rLaserSpotLength_mm * 0.001) / rGantryVelocity_Act;
ELSE
    rMaxIntimateContactTime := 0.250;
END_IF;

(* Lee-Springer intimate contact accumulation: D_ic = C * (P / mu * t)^0.2 *)
IF (rVotedFlashTemp_DegC >= rTemp_Melting_DegC) AND (rVotedNormalForce_N >= rForce_MinConsol_N) THEN
    rIntimateContactIntegral := rIntimateContactIntegral + ((rCompactionPressure_bar * 100000.0) / rResinViscosity_Pa_s) * rDt;
    rIntimateContactRatio := 0.28 * EXP(0.20 * LN(1.0 + (5.0 * rIntimateContactIntegral)));
    IF rIntimateContactRatio > 1.0 THEN rIntimateContactRatio := 1.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rIntimateContactIntegral := rIntimateContactIntegral * 0.985; (* Relaxation / cool down *)
    rIntimateContactRatio := rIntimateContactRatio * 0.990;
END_IF;

(* Through-thickness thermal gradient: (T_flash - T_substrate) / t_ply *)
rThermalGradient_C_mm := (rVotedFlashTemp_DegC - rSubstratePreheat_Temp) / rTapeThicknessNom_mm;

(* === STEP 5: STATE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE LASER THERMAL REGULATION === *)
(* Innovation Residual for Luenberger Observer *)
rTempObsError := rVotedFlashTemp_DegC - x_thermal_est[1];

(* Update Observer State Estimates: x(k) = A*x + B*u + L*(y - y_hat) *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rMatrixSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rMatrixSum := rMatrixSum + a_thermal[iRow, iCol] * x_thermal_est[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    x_thermal_est[iRow] := rMatrixSum
                           + b_thermal[iRow, 1] * rLaserPower_Feedback
                           + b_thermal[iRow, 2] * rGantryVelocity_Act
                           + l_observer_gain[iRow] * rTempObsError;
END_FOR;

(* 1-Step Receding Horizon Predictive State Estimation *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rMatrixSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rMatrixSum := rMatrixSum + a_thermal[iRow, iCol] * x_thermal_est[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    x_thermal_pred[iRow] := rMatrixSum
                            + b_thermal[iRow, 1] * rLaserPowerCmd_kW
                            + b_thermal[iRow, 2] * rGantryVelocity_Act;
END_FOR;

(* MPC Error Dynamics with Derivative Damping and Anti-Windup *)
rTempError := rTemp_TargetFlash_DegC - x_thermal_pred[1];
rTempDerivative := (rVotedFlashTemp_DegC - rPrevVotedTemp) / rDt;
rPrevVotedTemp := rVotedFlashTemp_DegC;

IF (iSequencerState = 50 OR iSequencerState = 60 OR iSequencerState = 80) THEN
    IF ABS(rTempError) < 45.0 THEN
        rTempErrorIntegral := rTempErrorIntegral + rTempError * rDt;
        IF rTempErrorIntegral > 150.0 THEN rTempErrorIntegral := 150.0;
        ELSIF rTempErrorIntegral < -150.0 THEN rTempErrorIntegral := -150.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTempErrorIntegral := rTempErrorIntegral * 0.995;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rTempErrorIntegral := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Multi-Variable Laser Control Law: Feedforward (Velocity + Acceleration) + MPC Feedback *)
rLaserPowerUnsat_kW := (rGantryVelocity_Act * rMPC_Feedforward_Speed)
                       + (rGantryAccel_Act * rMPC_Feedforward_Accel)
                       + (rMPC_Temp_Gain_P * rTempError)
                       + (rMPC_Temp_Gain_I * rTempErrorIntegral)
                       - (rMPC_Temp_Gain_D * rTempDerivative);

(* Saturation within Physical Diode Limits (0.0 to 12.0 kW) *)
IF (iSequencerState = 50 OR iSequencerState = 60 OR iSequencerState = 80) THEN
    IF rLaserPowerUnsat_kW > 12.0 THEN
        rLaserPowerCmd_kW := 12.0;
    ELSIF rLaserPowerUnsat_kW < 0.25 THEN
        rLaserPowerCmd_kW := 0.25; (* Keep simmer current *)
    ELSE
        rLaserPowerCmd_kW := rLaserPowerUnsat_kW;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iSequencerState = 30 OR iSequencerState = 40 THEN
    rLaserPowerCmd_kW := 0.15; (* Optical pilot / alignment power [kW] *)
ELSE
    rLaserPowerCmd_kW := 0.00; (* Shuttered / Emission Disabled *)
END_IF;

(* === STEP 6: COMPACTION SHOE NORMAL FORCE & CURVATURE REGULATION === *)
(* Tooling Curvature Compliance Feedforward: Convex (+), Concave (-) *)
IF rToolCurvatureRadius > 25.0 THEN
    rAbsCurvature := rToolCurvatureRadius;
ELSE
    rAbsCurvature := 25.0; (* Curvature singularity floor *)
END_IF;
rCurvatureOffset_N := rCurvatureComp_Gain / rAbsCurvature;

(* Force Error Dynamics *)
rForceError := rForce_TargetNominal_N + rCurvatureOffset_N - rVotedNormalForce_N;
rForceDerivative := (rVotedNormalForce_N - rPrevVotedForce) / rDt;
rPrevVotedForce := rVotedNormalForce_N;

IF (iSequencerState >= 40 AND iSequencerState <= 80) THEN
    IF ABS(rForceError) < 250.0 THEN
        rForceErrorIntegral := rForceErrorIntegral + rForceError * rDt;
        IF rForceErrorIntegral > 1200.0 THEN rForceErrorIntegral := 1200.0;
        ELSIF rForceErrorIntegral < -1200.0 THEN rForceErrorIntegral := -1200.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rForceErrorIntegral := rForceErrorIntegral * 0.990;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rForceErrorIntegral := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Closed-Loop Force Control Equation *)
rForceUnsat_N := (rForce_TargetNominal_N + rCurvatureOffset_N)
                 + (rMPC_Force_Gain_P * rForceError)
                 + (rMPC_Force_Gain_I * rForceErrorIntegral)
                 - (rMPC_Force_Gain_D * rForceDerivative);

(* Shoe Actuation Clamp *)
IF (iSequencerState >= 40 AND iSequencerState <= 80) THEN
    IF rForceUnsat_N > rForce_MaxSafe_N THEN
        rCompactionForceCmd_N := rForce_MaxSafe_N;
    ELSIF rForceUnsat_N < rForce_MinConsol_N THEN
        rCompactionForceCmd_N := rForce_MinConsol_N;
    ELSE
        rCompactionForceCmd_N := rForceUnsat_N;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCompactionForceCmd_N := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* === STEP 7: MULTI-STAGE SEQUENCING FINITE STATE MACHINE === *)
tStateDwellTimer(IN := (iSequencerState = iPreviousState), PT := T#120S);
tInertingTimer(IN := (iSequencerState = 10), PT := T#4S);
tTouchdownTimer(IN := (iSequencerState = 40), PT := T#1S500MS);
iPreviousState := iSequencerState;

CASE iSequencerState OF
    0: (* STATE_POWER_ON_SELF_TEST *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaserPermissive := FALSE;
        bCompactionEngaged := FALSE;
        bTapeFeedPermit := FALSE;
        IF bEnable AND bEStop AND bLaserSafetyInterlock AND (iPyroHealthyCount >= 2) AND (iLoadHealthyCount >= 2) THEN
            iSequencerState := 10; (* Proceed to Inerting Gas Purge *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_INERTING_AND_CHILLING_PURGE *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaserPermissive := FALSE;
        bCompactionEngaged := FALSE;
        bTapeFeedPermit := FALSE;
        IF tInertingTimer.Q THEN
            IF (rN2PurgeFlow_lpm >= 35.0) AND (rCoolingWaterFlow_lpm >= 8.5) AND (rCoolingWaterTemp_In <= 24.0) THEN
                iSequencerState := 20; (* Atmosphere purged, advance to sensor zero *)
            ELSE
                iSequencerState := 99; (* Insufficient gas purge or chiller trip *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_TMR_SENSOR_ALIGNMENT_AND_TARE *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaserPermissive := FALSE;
        bCompactionEngaged := FALSE;
        bTapeFeedPermit := FALSE;
        (* Verify baseline optical readings match substrate preheat within 10 C *)
        IF ABS(rVotedFlashTemp_DegC - rSubstratePreheat_Temp) < 15.0 THEN
            IF bTapePresent THEN
                iSequencerState := 30; (* Tape loaded, advance to standby *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_STANDBY_READY *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaserPermissive := TRUE;
        bCompactionEngaged := FALSE;
        bTapeFeedPermit := FALSE;
        IF bTapePresent AND (rGantryVelocity_Act > 0.005) THEN
            iSequencerState := 40; (* Gantry motion initialized, lower shoe *)
        ELSIF bDegradedModeActive THEN
            iSequencerState := 80; (* Degraded contingency mode *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_APPROACH_AND_LANDING *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaserPermissive := TRUE;
        bCompactionEngaged := TRUE;
        bTapeFeedPermit := TRUE;
        IF tTouchdownTimer.Q THEN
            IF (rVotedNormalForce_N >= rForce_MinConsol_N) AND (rShoeDisplacement_Act >= 0.5) THEN
                iSequencerState := 50; (* Shoe seated, ramp laser & feed *)
            ELSE
                iSequencerState := 90; (* Shoe landing failure *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_LAYDOWN_RAMP_ACCELERATION *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaserPermissive := TRUE;
        bCompactionEngaged := TRUE;
        bTapeFeedPermit := TRUE;
        IF (rGantryVelocity_Act >= 0.15) AND (rVotedFlashTemp_DegC >= rTemp_MinConsol_DegC) THEN
            iSequencerState := 60; (* Operating velocity and consolidation temp reached *)
        ELSIF bDegradedModeActive THEN
            iSequencerState := 80; (* Fallback to degraded profile *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_STEADY_CONSOLIDATION_CRUISE *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaserPermissive := TRUE;
        bCompactionEngaged := TRUE;
        bTapeFeedPermit := TRUE;
        IF (rGantryVelocity_Act < 0.08) THEN
            iSequencerState := 70; (* End of course deceleration and cut *)
        ELSIF bDegradedModeActive THEN
            iSequencerState := 80; (* Degraded mode detected during laydown *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_DECELERATION_AND_TAIL_CUT *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaserPermissive := FALSE; (* Immediate shutter cut on tape tail *)
        bCompactionEngaged := TRUE; (* Maintain shoe compaction dwell *)
        bTapeFeedPermit := FALSE;
        IF rGantryVelocity_Act <= 0.005 THEN
            iSequencerState := 30; (* Laydown complete, return to standby *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_DEGRADED_LAYDOWN_CONTINGENCY *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaserPermissive := TRUE;
        bCompactionEngaged := TRUE;
        bTapeFeedPermit := TRUE;
        (* Safety interlock: velocity must not exceed 0.20 m/s in degraded mode *)
        IF (iPyroHealthyCount < 1) OR (iLoadHealthyCount < 1) THEN
            iSequencerState := 90; (* Loss of secondary redundancy - abort *)
        ELSIF NOT bDegradedModeActive THEN
            iSequencerState := 60; (* Redundancy restored *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_ABORT_RETRACT *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaserPermissive := FALSE; (* Drop laser shutter instantaneously *)
        bCompactionEngaged := FALSE; (* Retract compaction shoe immediately *)
        bTapeFeedPermit := FALSE;
        IF rLaserPower_Feedback <= 0.05 AND rShoeDisplacement_Act <= 0.1 THEN
            iSequencerState := 99; (* Fully retracted and de-energized *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_LATCHED_FAULT_LOCKOUT *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaserPermissive := FALSE;
        bCompactionEngaged := FALSE;
        bTapeFeedPermit := FALSE;
        rLaserPowerCmd_kW := 0.0;
        rCompactionForceCmd_N := 0.0;
        IF bResetAlarms AND bEStop AND bLaserSafetyInterlock THEN
            iSequencerState := 0; (* Reset sequence back to cold POST *)
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        iSequencerState := 99;
END_CASE;

(* === STEP 8: CRITICAL SAFETY INTERLOCKS & IMMEDIATE TRIPS === *)
IF NOT bEStop OR NOT bLaserSafetyInterlock THEN
    iSequencerState := 90; (* SIL-3 Emergency Stop trip *)
END_IF;

IF (rVotedFlashTemp_DegC > rTemp_MaxSafeFlash_DegC) AND (iSequencerState >= 30) THEN
    iSequencerState := 90; (* Polymer resin thermal breakdown / flash ignition trip *)
END_IF;

IF (rVotedNormalForce_N > rForce_MaxSafe_N) AND (iSequencerState >= 40) THEN
    iSequencerState := 90; (* Structural shoe overload trip *)
END_IF;

IF (rN2PurgeFlow_lpm < 25.0) AND (iSequencerState >= 40) THEN
    iSequencerState := 90; (* Nitrogen inerting loss - flash fire mitigation trip *)
END_IF;

IF (rGantryVelocity_Act < 0.010) AND (rLaserPower_Feedback > 0.40) AND (iSequencerState >= 50) THEN
    iSequencerState := 90; (* Stationary laser exposure prevention trip *)
END_IF;

(* === STEP 9: 16-BIT SUBSYSTEM STATUS WORD ENCODING === *)
wStatusWord.0  := bSystemReady;
wStatusWord.1  := bLaserPermissive;
wStatusWord.2  := bCompactionEngaged;
wStatusWord.3  := bTapeFeedPermit;
wStatusWord.4  := (iSequencerState = 60); (* Steady-state laydown active *)
wStatusWord.5  := bDegradedModeActive;
wStatusWord.6  := (iPyroHealthyCount = 3);
wStatusWord.7  := (iLoadHealthyCount = 3);
wStatusWord.8  := (rIntimateContactRatio >= 0.95); (* Intimate contact achieved *)
wStatusWord.9  := bTapePresent;
wStatusWord.10 := (iSequencerState = 80); (* Running in degraded mode *)
wStatusWord.11 := (iSequencerState = 90); (* Aborting / retracting *)
wStatusWord.12 := (iSequencerState = 99); (* Latched lockout *)
wStatusWord.13 := bColdBootInitialized;
wStatusWord.14 := (rN2PurgeFlow_lpm >= 35.0);
wStatusWord.15 := (iSequencerState = 0);

(* === STEP 10: 32-BIT COMPREHENSIVE DIAGNOSTIC ALARM FIELD === *)
dwDiagnosticAlarms.0  := NOT bEStop;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.1  := NOT bLaserSafetyInterlock;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.2  := NOT bTapePresent;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.3  := NOT bPyro1_Healthy;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.4  := NOT bPyro2_Healthy;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.5  := NOT bPyro3_Healthy;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.6  := (iPyroHealthyCount < 2);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.7  := NOT bLoad1_Healthy;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.8  := NOT bLoad2_Healthy;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.9  := NOT bLoad3_Healthy;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.10 := (iLoadHealthyCount < 2);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.11 := (rVotedFlashTemp_DegC > rTemp_MaxSafeFlash_DegC);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.12 := (rVotedFlashTemp_DegC < rTemp_MinConsol_DegC) AND (iSequencerState = 60);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.13 := (rVotedNormalForce_N > rForce_MaxSafe_N);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.14 := (rVotedNormalForce_N < rForce_MinConsol_N) AND (iSequencerState = 60);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.15 := (rN2PurgeFlow_lpm < 30.0);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.16 := (rCoolingWaterFlow_lpm < 7.0);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.17 := (rCoolingWaterTemp_In > 28.0);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.18 := (rPyroDiff_12 > 22.0 OR rPyroDiff_23 > 22.0 OR rPyroDiff_31 > 22.0);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.19 := (rLoadDiff_12 > 65.0 OR rLoadDiff_23 > 65.0 OR rLoadDiff_31 > 65.0);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.20 := (iSequencerState = 99);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.21 := (rResinViscosity_Pa_s > 75000.0) AND (iSequencerState = 60);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.22 := (rLaserPowerCmd_kW >= 11.95); (* Laser power saturation limit *)
dwDiagnosticAlarms.23 := (rCompactionForceCmd_N >= 1580.0); (* Compaction force saturation limit *)
dwDiagnosticAlarms.24 := (rGantryVelocity_Act < 0.010) AND (rLaserPower_Feedback > 0.40);
dwDiagnosticAlarms.25 := FALSE;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.26 := FALSE;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.27 := FALSE;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.28 := FALSE;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.29 := FALSE;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.30 := FALSE;
dwDiagnosticAlarms.31 := (tStateDwellTimer.Q AND (iSequencerState <> 30) AND (iSequencerState <> 99));

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
